title: رها: توصیه بعد از برداشت تأییدشده
packet:
##BEINEMA_MODE=VOICE##
[ROOM]
title: گریهٔ صبح مدرسه
counselor: رها
[PARTICIPANTS]
OWNER=سارا
[BRIEF]
action=RESPOND
phase=ADVISE
addressee=OWNER (سارا)
purpose=give one concrete way to make the goodbye short and the same every day
do=The confirmed reading: staying at the gate until he calms keeps the goodbye going, so it happens twice. Advise from tomorrow: one short goodbye, the same every day: a hug, the sentence «دوستت دارم، بعد از مدرسه میام دنبالت», his hand in the teacher's hand, and leave even if he still cries. Say the first two or three days may be harder and it usually settles within one or two weeks. Then ask what she says to him at that moment now.
must_not=do not restate or paraphrase what they wrote, and do not state guesses about them
length=MEDIUM
lead=NONE
governance=NONE
safety=NONE

title: پوریا: هدف دور از دسترس
